validationScope: Deterministic schema and internal-contract validation only; this is not an independent quality evaluation and does not make a readiness judgment.

internalContractChecks.detail: Probe, protocol, targeted manifest, OCR evidence, and reconstruction parse as JSON.
56 of 56 cue texts, start/end times, representative frames, and overlapping-shot lists exactly match the supplied evidence pack.
Knowledge units, cues, probe entities, and targeted frame identifiers are unique.
Nine sweep regions cover 0.000-156.367 seconds without a contract-level gap; every available carrier is marked inspected and traced to a sweep region.
Every protocol knowledge-unit field, capture action, and required relation traces only to valid probe identifiers.
All 10 capture actions produced resolvable targeted frames; 110 targeted frames are present.
All 110 targeted frames have processed Vision OCR records; zero frames failed; 921 OCR line proposals are preserved.
Every cue, shot, targeted-frame, OCR, and declared-source reference used by the knowledge units and relations resolves.
Knowledge-unit ranges and all frame-localized evidence remain inside the 156.367-second source timeline with the contract tolerance.
Each system-inference unit has explicit reasoning and evidence; unknowns are retained rather than converted into positive facts.
All 10 carriers, 12 meaning changes, 10 relationship hypotheses, 17 critical questions, 56 transcript cues, and 16 core units are structurally accounted for.
All relation endpoints resolve to distinct knowledge units; there are no self-edges.
Opening and closing carrier conflicts are preserved as separate raw forms; neither is silently normalized.
The 11 technical shot-detection segments are explicitly kept separate from the observed semantic continuity of the whiteboard argument.
Masked-presenter referent limits, decision-relevant boundaries, scoped absence, and non-speech-audio uncertainty are explicit.
The required Chinese meta question is exact, with no declared unchecked channels, overlooked meaning changes, or overlooked relationships.
No banned global completeness percentage or equivalent score is present.
No evaluation artifact or gate-report artifact was created in the skill-run output.
